### The Well-Lived Life of Stephen
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-october-18-2025.html
Passage: Acts 6:8
Points:
- Stephen demonstrated that a well-lived life is marked by personal integrity and a trustworthy reputation.
- Being filled with the Holy Spirit requires submitting daily to God's direction rather than self-interest.
- True biblical wisdom means actively translating knowledge of Scripture into God-honoring conduct.
- God works through believers who humbly remain faithful in small, unglamorous tasks.
- Even when facing severe threats before his accusers, Stephen boldly seized the opportunity to share Christ.

### Day 231: Acts 6:8–15
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-231-acts-6-815.html
Passage: Acts 6:8-15
Points:
- Stephen's opponents could not overcome the wisdom and Spirit with which he spoke.
- Divine power in a yielded life always manifests alongside grace, meekness, and humility.
- Facing hostile religious leaders, Stephen reflected God's peace so clearly that his face seemed angelic.
- Instead of defending himself against trumped-up charges, he used the trial to proclaim God's redemptive story.
- Stephen's gracious testimony laid an enduring spiritual foundation that would later impact Saul of Tarsus.
